name: Agent-Reach
description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets an AI agent read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub and Chinese platforms directly, without paying for each platform's API.
buyer: A social-media growth marketer, market researcher, or content strategist who needs cross-platform trend and sentiment data without stacking expensive API subscriptions.
business_use_cases: A social-listening agency builds client trend reports by pulling mentions across Twitter, Reddit and YouTube in one pass.
A content strategist mines trending topics across platforms each morning to feed a content calendar.
A market researcher tracks competitor product mentions and sentiment across Western and Chinese platforms for a client expanding into new markets.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a weekly cross-platform trend report for a specific niche (e.g. skincare, fintech) to brand marketers.
Offer one-off competitor social-listening audits for brands entering a new market.

steal_this: Pull a week of cross-platform mentions for one niche this weekend, turn it into a sample trend report, and pitch it cold to three brands in that niche. Note: scraping social platforms can run against their terms of service, so check that before reselling data pulled this way.
